$comment: Built-in hook-replay scenario catalog (issue #1043). Each scenario maps a named, discoverable detector-development case to a fixture in this directory, the detector path it exercises, and the anomaly/finding a developer should expect. Consumed by scripts/replay-hooks.ts (`--list-scenarios`, `--scenario <name>`). Keep `fixture` paths relative to this directory and every entry replayable end-to-end (`--scenario <name> --dry-run` must parse cleanly without a server).

scenarios.name: idle-prompt
scenarios.purpose: Agent has gone idle and is waiting for user input — exercises the idle/attention routing path.
scenarios.expected: A single Notification event (notification_type=idle_prompt) that should surface the session as needing attention.

scenarios.name: permission-request
scenarios.purpose: Agent is blocked on a tool-permission decision — exercises the permission-gating attention path.
scenarios.expected: A PermissionRequest event for a Bash tool call, carrying permission_suggestions; the session should route as blocked-on-permission.

scenarios.name: tool-failure
scenarios.purpose: A tool call failed mid-task — exercises the tool-failure detector path.
scenarios.expected: A PostToolUseFailure event for a Read tool call with error 'File does not exist.'.

scenarios.name: billing-stop
scenarios.purpose: A run halted on a billing/credit error — exercises the stalled / credit-exhaustion detector.
scenarios.expected: A StopFailure event (error=billing_error, last_assistant_message 'Credit balance is too low').

scenarios.name: task-notification
scenarios.purpose: A subagent completion arrives wrapped in a UserPromptSubmit task-notification — exercises the synthetic-re-entry suppression path.
scenarios.expected: A UserPromptSubmit event whose prompt wraps a <task-notification> payload; the parser intentionally drops it (so the dry-run classifies it as 'unknown', not a user message).

scenarios.name: codex-mcp-startup
scenarios.purpose: A multi-record Codex MCP server startup sequence — exercises ordered, multi-event ingestion.
scenarios.expected: A sequence of records beginning with a Notification (mcp_startup_starting) followed by SessionStart and PreToolUse events.
